# ios-haptics

Source: https://github.com/tijnjh/ios-haptics/tree/43bede3aea8086dfa17c1e21431a5b0c6535a846

Unmodified source pinned at 43bede3aea8086dfa17c1e21431a5b0c6535a846. The npm 3.2.0 artifact still uses the older full-size input overlay, which can capture scroll gestures on Safari. This revision uses a label overlay and a hidden switch. Return to the registry dependency when its published build includes that fix.
